description: Ranks the four Walt Disney World theme parks for visiting right now, combining live crowd levels, today's forecast and remaining park hours. Returns each park's rank, live average wait, open/close times and a one-line reason. Disneyland Resort parks (disneyland, california-adventure) are accepted; they return quality_state "unavailable" until Disneyland Resort data is connected.

resort.description: Resort: "wdw" (Walt Disney World, the default) or "dlr" (Disneyland Resort). A park argument, when given, decides the resort.

name: which_park_today
title: Which park is best today
